source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of advanced concepts (PDF 60).

blocks.text: Advanced (aage ke) Python concepts bunyadi ilm ko barhate hain aur programmers ko zyada pecheeda kaam karne ke qabil banate hain. Is hisse mein do aham topics hain: exception handling, yani ghaltiyon ko saleeqe se sambhalna, aur file handling, yani files se parhna aur un mein likhna. Mazboot (robust) aur achhi Python applications ke liye yeh dono zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke do advanced topics bataiye.

items: Is hisse mein exception handling aur file handling.
